query: SELECT json_extract(r.payload, '$.record.holder.actor') AS "holder!: String", json_quote(json_extract(r.payload, '$.record.ended')) AS "ended!: String" FROM role_assignments a CROSS JOIN record_identities r ON r.kind = a.kind AND r.id = a.assignment_id WHERE a.project_subject = ? AND a.role = 'lead' AND a.active = 1 LIMIT 1
